rules: AstaPS authored substitutes for missing fishing/capture engines. Only these original quest IDs participate. Native dialogue/plot objectives are never completed by the field controller.

Fishing is a provided physical shore rig: cast, wait three seconds for the bite, hook within three seconds, then reel three times with 0.5-3 second intervals while staying within six metres. The rig provides tackle and bait; it does not silently deduct an item for an unimplemented native fishing UI. A real live fish entity and successful inventory admission are required before one source-table fish item and its task evidence are granted. These deterministic mechanics and supplied tackle are reconstructed, not official fishing behavior.

Native 3.4 Quest::isParamMatch establishes first fishing parameter 1=ordinary,2=furniture; FishExcelConfigMgr classifies fish_cate_id!=0 as furniture. The 7.1 second parameter5001 matches the native fishing pool5001. This reconstruction explicitly treats a positive second parameter as a pool filter; the newer official server predicate is unavailable.

Survey193 requires the actual current avatar10000130 and the exact original animal, followed by three seconds at close range. Missing trial-entry Lua is replaced with source-table trial1130 in a quest-owned mirror team. A real animal is removed without a kill reward after the survey. It does not claim to implement the missing native Linnea skill capture system.

Net145 requires the equipped and owned Omni-Ubiquity Net220043, three seconds near the real spawned finch, successful source drop21330032 reward admission, and actual consumption of one net. The original capture table maps finch28010101/tag1001 to drop21330032, whose guaranteed item is369113. Failed admission consumes nothing and grants no success.

Compass220009 retains the original widget allowCityId1 and gadget70500008. A real five-second compass points toward the nearest visible unopened chest within200m, reports whether a chest was found and saves a ten-second authored cooldown. The range/lifetime/cooldown are reconstructed. Merely requesting another unsupported widget does not count as use.
